class.name: NetwPersistenceConfig
class.brief_description: Which record of which [NetwDatabase] an entity loads and saves.
class.description:
The entity's record is one row of the table [method table] names, stored under the id [method record_id] answers. Its columns are the properties marked with [method NetwPropertyConfig.persisted] on the entity and on its child nodes, each under its saved column name. Configure it from [method Node._ready], where the node is in the tree. [codeblock] func _ready() -> void: Netw.configure_property(self, &"position", false).persisted(&"where") Netw.configure_persistence(self) \ .database(&"saves") \ .table(&"players") \ .record_id(account_name) \ .interval(5.0)
func account_name() -> StringName: return entity.entity_id [/codeblock] Use a [method record_id] that stays the same between sessions. A peer id changes every time the player joins. The record is reached through [member NetwEntity.persistence]. [b]Record layout[/b] A column's type is the declared type of its property, so an untyped property stores any [Variant] a save can hold. A stored record whose columns, names or types differ from the declared ones loads only through a [method migrate] step. Renaming a property while keeping its saved column name needs no migration. [codeblock] func _ready() -> void: Netw.configure_property(self, &"coins", false).persisted(&"gold") Netw.configure_persistence(self) \ .database(&"saves") \ .table(&"players") \ .storage_version(2) \ .migrate(1, add_gold) \ .record_id(account_name)
func add_gold(row: Dictionary) -> Dictionary: row[&"gold"] = 0 return row [/codeblock]

method.name: database
method.description: Names the [NetwDatabase] this entity's record lives in, as [method Netw.configure_database] declared it.

method.name: interval
method.description: Saves the record every [param seconds] when something changed. [code]0.0[/code] saves only when you call [method NetwPersistenceHandle.save]. [b]Server Only.[/b]

method.name: load_on_spawn
method.description: Whether the server loads the stored record when the entity's node is ready. Clients do not receive the entity until the load succeeds or finds no record. Call [method NetwPersistenceHandle.load] to retry a failed load.

method.name: migrate
method.description: Adds the step that turns a record stored at [param from_version] into the next version. [param step] receives the stored row as a [Dictionary] keyed by saved column name and returns the upgraded one. A load runs every step between the stored version and [method storage_version].

method.name: record_id
method.description: Sets the function that returns the id this entity's record is stored under. It is called once, when the entity's record is compiled, and must return a nonempty [StringName].

method.name: storage_version
method.description: Sets the version this entity's record is saved at, starting from [code]1[/code]. Raise it whenever a saved column is added, removed, renamed or retyped, and add a [method migrate] step from the previous version.

method.name: table
method.description: Names the table this entity's record is stored in. Every entity saving into one table declares the same saved columns, types and [method storage_version].
